## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical diagnostic skills for common VPN reliability issues in enterprise networks, requiring systematic troubleshooting across multiple potential failure points.

## Key Concepts
- IPsec SA monitoring and replay window behavior
- MTU/PMTU discovery and fragmentation in tunnel environments
- NAT state table management and exhaustion scenarios
- ECMP hashing consistency across multiple tunnel paths
- Peak-hour traffic pattern correlation

## Code Example

```bash
tcpdump -i any 'udp and port <telemetry-port>' -w /tmp/telemetry.pcap &
ip xfrm state show | grep -A5 <peer-ip>
ip xfrm policy show | grep <peer-ip>
ping -M do -s 1472 <siteB-peer> -c 100
conntrack -L | grep <telemetry-port>
ip route show table all | grep <siteB-network>
```

## Follow-up Questions

- What proactive monitoring would prevent similar telemetry reliability issues?
- How does your approach change if the VPN uses multiple Internet providers?
